newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway unit in management buyout.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway unit in management buyout.

text.p: Suncorp-Metway Ltd said on Friday the corporate advisory activities of its merchant bank Graham & Co had been sold following a management buyout involving the merchant bank's founder, David Graham.

Graham & Co's other activities including money market, treasury and securitisation would continue to operate and be integrated into Suncorp-Metway's core banking operations, Suncorp-Metway managing director Steve Jones said in a statement.
"This move will bring similar units in the group under common management and give them access to a bigger customer base," he said.
Corporate advisory activities were not core business for the Suncorp-Metway group, Jones said.
Suncorp-Metway shares were three cents lower at A$6.91 at 1.25 p.m. (0325 GMT).
